data.unit: seller-month with purchases in the feature month
data.outcome: log1p(sum of item price delivered to the customer in the next calendar month))
data.retrospective_secondary_outcome: next purchase-month item price of ultimately delivered orders
known_limitations: Payment entries and product/seller metadata are static snapshots without full revision histories; their availability at purchase is a working assumption, not proven live replay.
The primary target is delivery-month realized goods value, not the historical purchase-month retrospective target.
The final test period has been examined in prior exploratory work; this is not a pristine external confirmation sample.
Resampling sellers preserves within-seller rows but does not by itself prove Model-X exchangeability for dependent panel observations.

selection.rank_ties: fixed feature index after available method-native secondary scores

tuning.selection_metric: tuning RMSE, never final test RMSE
tuning.generator_hyperparameters: paper-prescribed default regularization; choose checkpoint using X-only held-out diagnostic loss
tuning.vtfs_adaptation: official variational transformer core; fixed-budget masked unique-token decoding and validation-only subset utilities are explicitly reported adaptations

stability.ci_unit: resampling group, never treat the two complementary halves as independent
stability.interpretation: conditional sensitivity on the observed dataset, not population-wide certainty

prediction.ci: paired seller-cluster bootstrap; conditional on the observed three test months
prediction.warning: Overlapping marginal confidence intervals do not establish equivalence; use paired differences.
prediction.model_choice: freeze on development data before opening test predictions

simulation.note: At K=12 and 5 true signals, FDP is at least 7/12 even for an oracle. Native thresholds and fixed budgets must not be mixed.
